periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is vertically oriented with a slight inward medial tilt toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly elongated oval morphology where vertical length significantly exceeds horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patch exhibits a downward vertical elongation that tapers toward the lower muzzle area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The dark ear regions are separated by a broad white cranial vertex approximately equal to 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae are predominantly rounded and convex.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-tan discoloration/staining on the white fur of the central chest and ventral region.
